Esteemed Interstellar Collectors, Cultural Scholars, and Honored Guests:

As stars turn in their orbits, rare treasures await. The Dragomi Brothers Auction House is honored to announce that we have accepted an exclusive commission from Mr. Cocott Solan, the energy magnate of the Silent Segmentum, to auction his long-held civilizational heritage in Astropolis in the near future. On behalf of Mr. Solan, we cordially invite you to grace us with your presence and partake in this exquisite collection gathered from the very edges of the cosmos.

Preview Information
Time: May 1–May 25, Year ██, 2158 AE
Location: Hall 3, Dragomi Art Center

Auction Information
Time: May 30, Year ██, 2158 AE
Location: Tide of Terminator Grand Hotel, Aquamarine Hall

Featured Previews
1. Omega Record — A gold-plated record aboard a sub-light speed space probe. It is engraved with information regarding the star system location and biological traits of the probe's senders, alongside greetings in 55 languages.
2. Symbiotic Corolla — A floral crown worn by successive monarchs of the planet Greenfuzz during their coronations. It could link with the wearer's consciousness to significantly enhance their cognitive abilities. The corolla withered after the establishment of a republic on Greenfuzz.
3. Thousand-Layer Lens — On the frigid planet Akto, indigenous inhabitants inlaid over a thousand ice crystals to form this precision observation instrument. Priests used it to capture minute disturbances in the clouds, interpreting them to provide brief but precious snowstorm warnings.
4. Montsella's Diary — A diary left behind by the renowned explorer Montsella during his journey through the Silent Segmentum. Although his ship tragically crashed on Theia-4b, this diary miraculously remained intact, going on to enlighten a brand-new space civilization.

Participation Guidelines
1. Credential Registration: Interested participants must submit a valid interstellar ID and proof of assets prior to the day of the auction. An exclusive bidding code will be issued upon approval.
2. Bidding Deposits: The deposit for a single item is 500,000 credits, and the all-access deposit is 2,000,000 credits.
3. Participation Methods: On-site attendance, remote access, and bidding via assigned proxy are all supported.

Notes
1. The Dragomi Art Center will host multiple themed salons during the preview period, inviting renowned cultural scholars to provide insights into the history and collectible value of the auction items. Please visit the official Dragomi Art Center website for a detailed schedule.
2. A portion of the proceeds from this auction will be donated to the Silent Segmentum Cultural Heritage Preservation Foundation to support the archaeology and research of civilizational ruins in frontier segmenta.
3. This invitation grants complimentary admission to the Dragomi Art Center during the preview period, allowing entry for you and up to two accompanying guests.

We look forward to meeting you in Astropolis. Together, we will witness these cultural treasures find their kindred spirits and write a new chapter in their immortal legacy.

Preserving Civilization Across Light-Years
Dragomi Brothers Auction House
